messages:
Maria Nunez: Quick sync — Azure/GCP marketplace asked for SOC2 summary, latest pen-test report, and an S3 artifact bundle (presigned upload) for listing. Need owners for presign flow, redaction, and ttl/retention. Target: submit by next Wed.
Devon Park: I can own the presign flow and S3 path. Will need the exact artifact list (pdfs + logs + attestations).
Samir Shah: Pen-test scope question — do they expect the 3P pen test (shared infra) or just our app+integration? This matters for scope & timeline.
Elaine Kim: They usually want a summary SOC2 + full report redacted, and pen-test summary + remediation attestation. I can take redaction if security gives the approved PII rules.
Devon Park: Proposed presign command/path: ```aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/<partner>/<listing-id>/bundle.zip --expires-in 604800``` TTL 7 days by default. We can generate temp creds and tag objects with retention metadata.
Samir Shah: For pen-scope: I'll confirm with security lead if infra components (hardware partners / SI connectors) must be included. If yes, timeline jumps ~2 weeks.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace upload window opens in 5 business days. See https://marketplace.portal/uploads for limits.
Maria Nunez: KMS question — the listing owner wants to see key origin. For Private deployments we can provide HSM attestation, for hosted we provide KMS key id + rotation policy. Who can draft the key attestation snippet?
Elaine Kim: I will draft key attestation and redaction checklist. Can someone share the SOC2 summary doc (control mapping + date)?
Devon Park: Upload playbook (for presign + metadata): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-presign — includes required manifest.json schema. Example manifest: ```{
  "listing_id": "acme-connector",
  "artifacts": ["soc2-summary.pdf","pen-test-summary.pdf","attestation.txt"],
  "contact": "security@redwood.ai"
}```
Samir Shah: Action: I'll confirm pen-scope with Security by EOD tomorrow. If they want 3P infra, I'll ask vendor to provide their pen report or scope statement.
Maria Nunez: Action: Elaine owns redaction + key attestation. Devon owns presign + upload manifest. Samir owns pen-scope confirmation. I'll consolidate and send to partner once we have redacted artifacts. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have the docs or questions.
Elaine Kim: Got it — will start redaction pass and share checklist by EOD.
Devon Park: Will start generating presign flow and mock manifest today, will post link when ready.
Samir Shah: Confirmed I'll sync with Security and loop in the vendor if needed.
Maria Nunez: Great — if no blockers, plan to package and upload Thu morning for partner review on Thu afternoon.
marketplace-bot: Upload window: 2025-09-18T09:00Z — 2025-09-25T09:00Z (automated reminder)
Maria Nunez: Thanks all — ping me directly if anything slips.
